0022600183.text: The Trail Blazers, who are 4-1 and first in the Northwest, are 3-0 on the road and have won their last game, visit the Phoenix Suns, who are 1-3 after two straight losses and sit 2.5 games back of third place in the Pacific. Portland will be without Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), while Phoenix will be without Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery). Portland leads this season's series 1-0 after its 124-83 win in Portland on October 21, and it lost the 2025-26 series 1-2.
